in2forex wrote: Hi Kruger Sorry for butting in on your journal but I must get this off my chest!...

Hi all, in2forex, thank you for this post.

I really do not mind if you guys post your charts exploring my entries or with trading ideas or with interesting observed nuances etc. because I enjoy constructive exchange of views. I don't post for myself to track progress anymore or to simply impress. It was fun at the beginning of understanding, now it's just a regular everyday, more mechanical bit boring (but still enjoyable:)).

Now, to the point, do not expect that any trader here, regardless of the color of the star, will be you personal trainer. IT WON'T WORK for both sides.

No matter how many answers you will get - without understanding of basics, your mind won't see what is obvious! It takes time but there's no shortcuts.

To the charts, traders!:)
